method: Read-only native redirect inventory and site configuration, plus retained native template bodies. No Wikipedia writes.

discussionBanner.casePolicy: Native first-letter template title identity. Other internal letter changes are not inferred.
discussionBanner.arguments: One configured banner retains its exact argument suffix and takes precedence over plain peers. Identical configurations can be deduplicated. Different configurations are retained.

biography.collisionPolicy: Only one supplied alias in the native catalogue family; conflicting aliases and their precedence are retained.

citations.method: Verified native CS1 argument forwarding, global aliases and exact module-specific reader roles. The source may be consumed despite a native unknown-field diagnostic; the target must be accepted. Full role sets, literal values, indices and collision precedence are retained.
citations.dates: The eight roles passed to native date validation, plus the episode AirDate handoff. Calendar identity and precision are retained. Full valid embargo dates use native-compatible ISO; incomplete and ambiguous dates are not completed.
citations.unknownOrEnglishOnlyNativeParameters: Retained where a Portuguese native equivalent is not certified.
citations.technicalException: At pinned CS1 revision72936771, the Vancouver parser reads raw args.vauthors/args.veditors after alias selection. The established Portuguese-to-English repair is preserved; these English raw keys are not localized back to the broken aliases.

portals.source: Read-only retained corpus, snapshot 2026-10-01. Source bodies decompressed and hashed before use. No new network requests.
portals.scope: Complete literal implicit positions or explicit numeric positions 1 through 10 in top-level Portal/Portal3 calls. Named options, unknown owners, ambiguous terms and source examples are preserved.
portals.countScope: Dictionary entries, literal alias output values and lookup pages are counted separately from canonical renderer destinations. Different lookup names can resolve to one native portal.

articleDraftScope: Explicit full-page wikitext user subpages named Testes or Rascunho. Ordinary user pages, code extensions, template/module paths and active transclusion definitions are excluded.
